description: Implementation of LIN State Machine (LinSM) for AUTOSAR, managing communication modes, scheduling, and timers.

methods.name: LinSM_Init
methods.description: Initializes the LIN State Machine, setting default statuses and timers.

methods.name: LinSM_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the LIN State Machine, resetting status.

methods.name: LinSM_ScheduleRequest
methods.description: Requests a schedule change for a LIN channel.

methods.name: LinSM_GetCurrentComMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current communication mode of a LIN channel.

methods.name: LinSM_RequestComMode
methods.description: Requests a change in communication mode for a LIN channel.

methods.name: LinSM_ScheduleRequest_Confirmation
methods.description: Handles confirmation of schedule request, starting/stopping PDU groups.

methods.name: LinSM_WakeUp_Confirmation
methods.description: Handles wake-up confirmation, updating status and indications.

methods.name: LinSM_GotoSleep_Confirmation
methods.description: Handles sleep mode confirmation, updating status and indications.

methods.name: LinSM_TimerTick
methods.description: Decrements timers and handles timeout errors for LIN channels.
